title: Multi-Model Red Team: Using One Model Family to Generate Scheming Prompts for Another

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: cross-model red-teaming -> if more effective than human prompts, becomes standard scalable evaluation tool -> improves scheming detection coverage. Addresses scalability of safety testing.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires coordinating two different model families, generating adversarial prompts, and measuring scheming rates. Multi-model orchestration and scheming rate measurement add complexity beyond beginner level.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Need to: set up cross-model pipeline, generate prompts, test effectiveness, compare with human baselines. Multiple components and the comparison adds scope. Tight for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
